MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 9, January 10, 1936 ]
CREATING A COMMITTEE TO BE KNOWN AS THE GENERAL COMMITTEE OF PRESIDENT
ROOSEVELT'S BIRTHDAY CELEBRATION
There is hereby created a committee to be known as the General Committee on President Roosevelt's
Birthday Celebration, to be composed of the following members:
Honorable Juan Posadas, Chairman; Hon. Teofilo Sison; Mr. Arsenio N. Luz; Mr. Samuel Gaches; Dr. Tirso
Abad; Gen. Basilio J. Valdes; Dr. Jose Fabella; Col. Paulino Santos; Father Henry C. Avery; Mrs. Jaime C. de
Vera; Miss Bessie A. Dwyer; Mrs. Pilar Hidalgo Lim; Mrs. Josefa Lanes Escoda; Judge Manuel Camus; Mr.
E. S. Turner; Mr. E. E. Voss; Mrs. Asuncion A. Perez; Mrs. Geronima T. Pecson; Mrs. Josefa Jara Martinez;
Miss Rosa Militar; Mr. H. M. Cavender; Mrs. J. J. Elizalde; Mr. Andres Soriano; Mr. Enrique Vasquez-Frada;
Miss Guillermina Mendoza; Dr. Jorge Bocobo; Maj. J. E. H. Stevenot; Mr. Joaquin B. de Tavera; Miss
Marguerite Wolfson; Miss Macaria Madrigal; Miss Maria Marta Albert; Miss Eloisa Burgos; Mr. Pedro
Syquia; Mr. Alfonzo Sy Cip; Mr. Dee C. Chuan; Mr. S. Dazai; Mr. Alejandro Roces, Sr.; Mr. Roy C. Bennett;
Mr. W. W. Larkin; Mr. Thomas J. Wolff; Mr. Salvador Araneta; Capt. J. V. Ogan, representing United States
High Commissioner Murphy; Maj. C. H. Gerhardt, U. S. A., representing General Kilbourne; Lt. B. R.
Harrison, U. S. N., representing Admiral Marquart; and Mr. Vicente Bunuan, Secretary.
